limitation.title: Complaint to the consumer commission

workflow.text: Chart the service, the deficiency and the loss.
Draft the complaint with the pecuniary jurisdiction facts.
Review the draft against the record.

intakeQuestions: What was bought or hired and for how much?
What was the deficiency and when did it occur?
What loss did the complainant suffer?
Which commission has the pecuniary jurisdiction?
evidence: The invoice and the payment record

terms.meaning: The shortfall in the quality, nature or manner of performance the Act defines.

provisions: Sections 41 and 51 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

workflow.text: Review the draft against the record.

evidence: The complaint and the written version

terms.meaning: The amount the appellant deposits before the appeal is heard.
The trader, manufacturer or service provider the complaint is against.
